hello.text: Come in, come in! Sit anywhere that isn't Gil. He's been in that chair since the lake froze last winter.

t0.text: Depends what you're buying. Edric Ashby's not speaking to his sister. Corin Vale bet his boots on a bear and lost. And Father Wren's been reading old books with the door shut, which he never does.

t1.text: Best beds this side of the mountains. Only beds this side of the mountains, but still.
